description: How one analytical diagram is made inside the dossier process: spec, primitive, format, enforcement, style, render, vision check, one revision. Diagrams, never illustrations.

phases.phase_description: The spine's commissioned exhibit becomes a FigureSpec: claim, data, primitive candidates.
One of twelve primitives; a visual format from the catalogue.
v1's format enforcement and global prohibitions; duplicate formats rejected.
One of six styles applied as a directive.
2K through the image fleet (Gemini 3 Pro Image by default).
Claude vision judges it as a diagram against the spec; one revision if it fails.

output_description: A labelled analytical diagram with its spec and compliance record.
